papers.title_en: A Confidence-Aware Multimodal Fusion Framework for Industrial Human-Robot Collaboration
papers.authors: Xinyu Liu, Qiqi Dong, Boya Jia, Yi Zhang, Binbin Lian
papers.evidence: 融合注视的多模态实时人体意图预测
papers.tldr: 面向工业人机协作中人类意图预测易受模态质量与环境干扰影响的问题，本文提出置信度感知多模态融合框架CAMF。该方法融合物体6D位姿、视线、骨骼运动和IMU手部运动。它将置信度趋势驱动的动态融合机制嵌入BiLSTM，按实时模态可靠性平衡双向时序特征，并用置信度引导平衡学习与冻结机制抑制低质模态噪声。在UR3协作机器人平台上，意图识别准确率达91.86%，优于现有融合方法，且在低光与部分遮挡下保持稳定，支持主动稳定协作。
papers.abstract_en: A confidence-aware multimodal fusion framework (CAMF) is proposed to realize reliable human intention prediction for industrial human-robot collaboration. This framework fuses four heterogeneous modalities including object 6D pose, gaze, skeletal motion and IMU-based hand motion. It embeds a confidence-trend-driven dynamic fusion mechanism into BiLSTM to adaptively balance bidirectional temporal features according to real-time modality reliability. A confidence-guided balanced learning strategy combined with a confidence freezing mechanism is further adopted to adjust network gradients dynamically, suppress noise from low-quality modalities and mitigate cross-modal learning bias. A physical platform based on the UR3 collaborative robot is built for experimental validation. Comparative results show that the proposed method reaches an intention recognition accuracy of 91.86% and outperforms existing multimodal fusion approaches in overall performance and stability. It also maintains satisfactory accuracy under low light and partial occlusion interference. In practical assembly tasks, the framework enables proactive and stable human-robot cooperation with strong environmental adaptability.

papers.title_en: RAMamba-Net: A Reliability-Aware and Mamba-Based Multimodal Fusion Network for Auditory Attention Detection
papers.authors: Xingyi He, Ziwei Wang, Dongrui Wu
papers.evidence: 融合脑电与眼电信号服务人机交互
papers.tldr: 听觉注意力解码（AAD）从生理信号识别被注意说话人，但EEG在自然视听场景中证据不完整，EEG-EOG融合受跨模态交互弱、时序建模低效和鲁棒性差限制。RAMamba-Net用Mamba增强的频带感知卷积Transformer与双分支时空编码器提取特征，并用跨模态注意力和可靠性感知模块进行样本级模态加权。AAD基准上，较单模态基线提升5.76%准确率，解码更稳健，抑制不可靠模态证据。为神经导向助听和自然人机交互提供可靠多模态AAD方案。
papers.abstract_en: Auditory attention decoding (AAD) identifies the attended speaker from physiological signals, supporting neuro-steered hearing devices and natural human-machine interaction. Electroencephalography (EEG) is the dominant modality for AAD but provides incomplete evidence in naturalistic audio-visual scenes, motivating EEG and electrooculography (EOG) fusion. Existing approaches remain limited by weak cross-modal interaction, inefficient temporal modeling, and low robustness to sample variations. To address the limitations, we propose RAMamba-Net, a reliability-aware Mamba-based multimodal fusion network for AAD. RAMamba-Net employs a Mamba-enhanced band-aware convolutional Transformer to capture band-specific EEG patterns and long-range temporal dynamics. A dual-branch temporal-spatial encoder models EOG temporal and inter-channel dependencies. Cross-modal attention enables explicit modality interaction. Then, a reliability-aware module is introduced to estimate sample-wise modality weights for feature and prediction consistency, thereby enhancing multimodal fusion. Experiments on two AAD benchmarks demonstrate that RAMamba-Net effectively exploits complementary EEG-EOG information, yielding accuracy gains of 5.76% over unimodal baselines, together with more robust decoding and discriminative representations. Further analyses show that explicit cross-modal interaction improves multimodal alignment, while the reliability-aware module suppresses unreliable modality evidence and is robust to signal perturbation and parameter variation.
